svg.title: FRONTIER Act developer tiers
svg.desc: Nested boxes showing the bill's three tiers: frontier developers above 10^26 training operations, large frontier developers adding revenue and spend tests of $50M and $1B, and very large frontier developers adding $5B and $10B tests, with their obligations.
svg.text: FRONTIER Act (H.R. 9925): three tiers of developer
Tests are cumulative: each inner tier also meets every outer test
Trained, or started training, a model using more than 10²⁶ operations
Transparency report before deployment · critical incident reporting
Plus over $50M gross revenue and $1B+ AI development spend over 36 months
Publish and follow a “frontier AI framework” for catastrophic risk
Plus over $5B gross revenue and $10B+ AI development spend over 36 months
Retain a licensed Independent Verification Organization (IVO),
assessed at least every six months
Incident reports: within 72 hours, or 24 hours if there is an imminent risk of death or serious injury.
